from.place: Bounded normalization of the etale scalar mate

lean.statement:
theorem scalarMatePlusNormalization
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (∀ N : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)),
      IsIso ((scalarRestrictionDirectImageMap φ f).app N.obj)) ∧
    (∀ (K : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
      (M : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)))
      (η : K ⟶ (Sheaf.restrictScalars X.smallEtaleTopology φ).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj M),
      (Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
        (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars Y.smallEtaleTopology φ)).unit.app
          (R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj K.obj) ≫
        (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars Y.smallEtaleTopology φ).map
          ((scalarMate φ f).app K.obj ≫
            R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f).map
              (((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
                (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars X.smallEtaleTopology φ)).homEquiv
                  K.obj M.obj).symm η.hom)) =
        (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility.inv.app K ≫
          (((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map η ≫
            (asIso (rightDerivedLowerStarRestrictScalars φ f)).inv.app M).hom) ≫
          (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars Y.smallEtaleTopology φ).map
            ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f).rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility.hom.app
              M))

title: Bounded normalization of the etale scalar mate
statement: For an arbitrary map of commutative rings φ:A→B and arbitrary scheme morphism f:X→Y, use the actual scalar extension adjunction S_T⊣U_T and canonical scalar/pullback isomorphism lambda [lem-pur-etale-scalar-mate-projection]. Let beta:S_Y Rf_A→Rf_B S_X be its geometric mate and delta:U_Y Rf_B→Rf_A U_X the mate of the canonical exact restriction/pullback square [lem-sbc-canonical-restrict-scalars-functor-comparisons]. Then delta_N is invertible for every N∈D⁺(X,B). For K∈D⁺(X,A), M∈D⁺(X,B), eta:K→U_X M, and c:S_X K→M its scalar-adjoint transpose, unit_Y followed by U_Y(beta_K followed by Rf_B(c)) equals Rf_A(eta) followed by the inverse canonical D+ restriction/direct-image comparison, after the standard inclusion isomorphisms. This is the equality displayed verbatim in lean.statement. No finiteness, properness or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Transport the ambient restriction mate along the exact-versus-left-derived inverse-image isomorphisms. The formula for mates under a left-adjoint isomorphism identifies it with the mate of the exact derived square.

Apply the full-subcategory restriction formula for the derived adjunction counit. The bounded restriction-adjunction counit identity, naturality of the exact inverse-image square, and injectivity of the geometric adjunction transpose identify delta_N with U_Y of the inverse D+ inclusion comparison, then the bounded restriction comparison, then the A inclusion comparison. Each factor is invertible.

Transpose unit_Y followed by restriction of beta and delta through the A-geometric adjunction. Apply the two mate counit equations and naturality of the restriction square. The scalar-pullback unit equality replaces the middle factors by the X scalar unit. Naturality of that unit and of the A-geometric counit give Rf_A of the X scalar unit.

Naturality of delta moves Rf_B(c) across it. The scalar adjunction transpose equation gives eta. Substitute the bounded formula from step 2 and cancel the invertible comparison. Naturality of the right-derived D+ inclusion isomorphism gives the displayed normalized formula.
